name: BonusPrize
styleKeywords: Bonus Prize = consumer surface (compra, gana, explora). User NEVER sees Storu.
Storu = merchant dashboard (crea campanas, mide, optimiza). Merchant NEVER sees Bonus Prize brand, only as distribution channel.
Bru = cultural/narrative layer — explica, educa, convierte.
Never mix Bonus Prize + Storu on same surface. The only bridge is the campaign/ticket object.
Product thesis: operating system for consumption — not a marketplace, not a discount system.
Core loop: merchant designs campaign (Storu) -> user buys (Bonus Prize) -> user earns -> user returns. Not a sale, a loop.
User tagline: No compres por comprar. Compra para ganar.
Merchant tagline: No vendas con descuentos. Diseña sistemas que te hagan vender más.
North star: No estamos cambiando como compras. Estamos cambiando por que compras.
Differentiator is the LOGIC (incentives as system), not cashback or tech.
User-side feel: simple, rapido, obvio (esto me conviene).
Visual system: ink-first structure, violet for action only, prize yellow only for reward moments.
Anton uppercase display for marketing headlines, Poppins 400-700 for body/UI.
16px card radius, 1px #e8e8e8 borders, flat surfaces, elevation only on overlays.
Storu logo at /uploads/8503ba56-ee7c-476b-87d5-31e42d1eac77.png — use ONLY on merchant-facing carousels, never alongside Bonus Prize.
